lines.en: The night sky is wide enough for three more circles.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过云，像刀划开布。
lines.en: My wings slice the clouds like a blade through cloth.
I skim low along the line of your roof.

lines.zh: 风从翼尖漏下去，呼呼响。
lines.en: Wind leaks from my wingtips with a hollow whistle.
One more loop and I am right above you.

lines.zh: 这片天我熟，闭眼都不撞树。
lines.en: I know this sky well enough to fly it blind.

lines.zh: 月光把我的影子投在你床边。
lines.en: Moonlight throws my shadow onto your bedside.

lines.zh: 我飘得很轻，只有风声大。
lines.en: I drift light as ash; only the wind is loud.
The deeper the night, the steadier my flight.

lines.zh: 低空掠过草尖，露水全惊散。
lines.en: Skimming the grass tips, I scatter every dewdrop.

lines.zh: 绕着你家转，是今晚的活儿。
lines.en: Circling your house is tonight's whole job.
My wing membrane pulls taut like a torn sail.

lines.zh: 数到第几个夜了？我忘了。
lines.en: Which night is this? I stopped counting.

lines.zh: 你床头的灰，比我飞得还久。
lines.en: The dust by your bed has rested longer than I have flown.
I am not sleepy. I have never been sleepy.
When the sun comes up, I must hide.

lines.zh: 有人欠我一夜觉，很久了。
lines.en: Someone owes me a night's sleep, and it has been long.

lines.zh: 我在等灯灭，等得很耐心。
lines.en: I am waiting for the lamp to go out, very patiently.

lines.zh: 骨头里没肉，风一吹就响。
lines.en: There is no flesh on my bones; the wind plays me.
Sleepers are the most fun of all.

lines.zh: 翼尖破了，我自己补不上。
lines.en: My wingtip is torn and I cannot mend it.

lines.zh: 安静，让我听听谁在翻身。
lines.en: Quiet — let me hear who is turning over.

lines.zh: 眼睛睁这么圆，是怕闭上？
lines.en: Eyes that wide — afraid to close them?
I recognize the blue-grey under your eyes.
Look at me. Do not blink.

lines.zh: 三天了，你一次都没躺下。
lines.en: Three days now, and you have not once lain down.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone uneven; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我数过你的哈欠，十一个。
lines.en: I counted your yawns. Eleven.

lines.zh: 你把灯点着，是给自己壮胆？
lines.en: You lit that lamp to keep your courage up?
Look up. I am directly overhead.

lines.zh: 别躲进屋里，屋顶挡不住我。
lines.en: Do not hide indoors; a roof will not stop me.

lines.zh: 你身上有股熬夜的酸味。
lines.en: You carry the sour smell of a sleepless man.
A bone cracked. What a crisp sound.
Pain is only an echo to me.

lines.zh: 打碎翼膜没用，我还能飞。
lines.en: Tearing my membrane will not ground me.
You struck wind. Almost.
The undead hardly mind losing a few bones.
That one, I will remember.
My blood dried long ago. Do not hope.
You hit hard. Pity you are slow.
My wing is crooked; let me correct it.
That screech was not fear.

lines.zh: 我不吃庄稼，只吃你的清醒。
lines.en: I do not eat crops; I feed on your wakefulness.

lines.zh: 别拿面包晃，那东西不香。
lines.en: Do not wave bread at me; it smells of nothing.
Gold? I do not even have pockets.

lines.zh: 真正勾我的，是你还睁着眼。
lines.en: What truly draws me is that your eyes are still open.
The longer you hold out, the closer I come.
Sleepiness is yours, and I refuse to grant it.

lines.zh: 我闻见咖啡味了，真刺鼻。
lines.en: I smell coffee on you. Sharp stuff.

lines.zh: 你这盏灯，比月亮还碍事。
lines.en: That lamp of yours is more in the way than the moon.
Do not coax me. The undead do not listen to coaxing.
Hand over the bed and I will leave.
One bump, one rattle of bone.
Your shoulder is harder than it looked.
Do not shove; I am already drifting.

lines.zh: 翼膜擦过你的盔甲，沙沙响。
lines.en: My membrane scrapes your armor with a dry rasp.
Step back a pace; I want to land.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没睡。
lines.en: We collided, and neither of us slept.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈味，扎鼻子。
lines.en: You smell of rust, and it stings my nose.
One touch and you flinch. Such a timid thing.
I drift along, and you insist on blocking the way.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，声音不好听。
lines.en: Bone against bone makes an ugly sound.

lines.zh: 幻翼不配对，我们各飞各的。
lines.en: Phantoms do not pair up; we fly alone.

lines.zh: 别指望我下蛋，我连窝都没有。
lines.en: Do not expect eggs from me; I have no nest.
There is only me and the night.

lines.zh: 同伴？上一次见是三天前。
lines.en: Kin? The last one I saw was three nights ago.
We do not grow close; we only screech together.

lines.zh: 你找错生物了，我不成双。
lines.en: You have the wrong creature; I do not come in pairs.
When membranes touch, it is only a fight.
A lonely undead keeps no mate.
Do not touch my neck bone; it would snap.

lines.zh: 夜里只有回声跟我说话。
lines.en: Only the echo talks to me at night.
I have no hands; I cannot pick it up.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我踩过就算。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the ground, I merely pass over.
That membrane is mine, shed — leave it.

lines.zh: 我爪尖太细，夹不住石头。
lines.en: My talons are too fine to grip a stone.
Pick it up; I will not quarrel over it.

lines.zh: 金子和骨头，我都不需要。
lines.en: I need neither gold nor bone.
Nothing can ride beneath these wings.

lines.zh: 地上的亮东西晃我的眼。
lines.en: Bright things on the ground dazzle me.
My only pocket is full of wind.
Dropped is dropped; the night is still long.

lines.zh: 找到了，那个三天没合眼的。
lines.en: Found him — the one who has not closed his eyes in three days.
Locked on. You cannot outrun wings.
You will do. I smell the weariness on you.
The target looks up. Perfect.

lines.zh: 别动，让我记住你的位置。
lines.en: Hold still and let me memorize your position.
I chose the one who slept latest.
I come down out of the clouds for you alone.
One screech to announce the opening.

lines.zh: 你身后的火把照不到我。
lines.en: The torch behind you does not reach me.
Tonight I have my eye on you.

lines.zh: 别以为躲进洞里就安全。
lines.en: Do not think a hole will keep you safe.
Wings fold; the dive begins.
Still awake? Then keep me company first.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶的影子认出你。
lines.en: I know you by the shadow you cast.

lines.zh: 你在屋檐下躲，我就在檐上。
lines.en: You hide under the eaves; I am on them.
One circle, to see where you hide.
Closer now. No hurry.
Dropping altitude, grazing the treetops.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙不会帮你。
lines.en: You back to the wall — the wall will not help.

lines.zh: 风往你那边吹，我顺风来。
lines.en: The wind blows your way; I ride it in.
My shadow reaches your feet first.
Wings tucked, my sound drops away.
I count your steps. One, two, three.
Do not look up. Looking up is already too late.

lines.zh: 你喘得越重，我贴得越近。
lines.en: The heavier you breathe, the closer I press.
Turn a corner — I am still above you.
My fangs are already lined up with your shoulder.
The night wind measures the distance for me.
You stand in the light; I wait outside it.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，风替我遮声。
lines.en: I circle behind you; the wind covers my sound.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我贴着屋顶滑。
lines.en: You look up for me; I skim the rooftop.

lines.zh: 你的火把灭了，我就能更低。
lines.en: Your torch is out, so I can drop lower.

lines.zh: 这一圈我飞得比刚才慢。
lines.en: This circle I fly slower than the last.
Teeth in your shoulder. Do not shout.
One dive, and you will remember it three days.
This bite pays for one night's sleep.
Claws first, fangs after.
You flinched. I saw it.
Blood runs warm; the night runs cold.
Do not cover your throat; it is your shoulder I bite.
Hold out longer and I will come again.
My teeth are full of night wind.
When you fall, I fold my wings just right.
This claw mark is a keepsake.
If it hurts, sleep — and I will go.
You raise that shield far too slowly.
After this bite, I loop back around.

lines.zh: 爪子勾住你的披风，撕开了。
lines.en: My claws catch your cloak and tear it.

lines.zh: 我撞在你背上，你就趴下了。
lines.en: I hit your back, and you go down.
Three days without sleep — I have come to collect.

lines.zh: 从你头顶的夜空里，我成形了。
lines.en: Out of the sky above you, I took shape.
The bed stands empty, so here I am.
Your yawning woke me.
The clouds part, and down I come.

lines.zh: 我不是被召来的，是被熬出来的。
lines.en: I was not summoned; I was brewed out of your staying awake.

lines.zh: 第一声尖啸，送给不睡的人。
lines.en: First screech, dedicated to the one who will not sleep.
My membrane unfolds in the moonlight.
Above your roof, I opened my eyes.
Another one who refuses to shut his eyes.
I peeled myself out of the dark.
While you count sheep, I count you.
The wind delivered me beneath your window.

lines.zh: 别问从哪来，问就是你没睡。
lines.en: Do not ask where I came from. Ask why you are awake.
The firelight is too bright for me.

lines.zh: 我本来就往下掉，这不叫摔。
lines.en: I fall by nature; this is not a crash.

lines.zh: 水灌进骨头缝，冷得刺耳。
lines.en: Water fills my bones, cold and shrill.
The blast leaves my membrane ringing.
The arrow sticks in bone like a thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进骨头，痒得难受。
lines.en: Magic crawls through my bones, an awful itch.
Hungry? I forgot that feeling long ago.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我骨头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and my bones lit up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有夜，也没有风。
lines.en: The void has no night and no wind.
